'''New Bakstre system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[New Bakstre]].
